title: Tunisian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from Tunisia, featuring tender lamb kebabs grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of couscous or bread for a delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim any excess fat

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use 1-2 cloves depending on your taste

ingredients.name: Ginger, grated
ingredients.notes: Use fresh ginger for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Ground cumin is fine, but whole cumin seeds are better

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika adds a nice smokiness

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt or sea salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a nice freshness

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
